structured.answer: I'd open an account at פסגות and buy "אי.בי.אי. מחקה (4A) ת"א 125" (5112628). With the page's own example of 10,000 ₪ plus 500 ₪ a month for 10 years at 7%, that comes to about 86,045 ₪ after fees and tax. I couldn't set my own 30,000, so for my money it would be more, but I don't know how much.

stuck.why: Leumi is a bank I know, Psagot less so; I hesitated before going with the top one because it was ~3,000 more
Minus signs everywhere, even on the chosen fund; looked like losses
